voScript.text: It rained last night, and now your floor mat is soaked.
It's probably not a window leak.
Leaves clog the drain channel under your wiper cowl.
Water backs up instead of draining outside.
It spills into the vent intake, then drips down under your dash.
A musty smell can be one clue something's damming up there.
Clear the leaves, or stop by and we'll take a look.
